item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 06/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Meanwhile, the weather will be hot during the day and winds will be weak over the region. A strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. There will be a few showers over the region. A southerly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week. It will be hot with a few showers over the region.
